name: Cache Visualization
description: Visualizes render-cache metadata (tags, contexts, max-age) directly on rendered pages to help developers debug caching problems.
project_description: Cache Visualization (cacheviz) is a Drupal 11 developer tool that visually highlights and analyzes render-cache metadata directly on the page. It decorates core's Renderer to wrap cacheable render-array output in HTML comments carrying that element's cache tags, contexts and max-age, then a JavaScript panel parses those comments and renders an interactive dashboard: color-coded highlights for uncacheable (max-age: 0), per-user, session and cookie-varying elements, grouped issues by severity, a searchable element list, and a bubble-chain view that traces how max-age: 0 propagates up the DOM to its root cause. It exposes internal cache metadata and is intended for development/staging only, gated behind the restricted 'view cacheviz debug' permission plus configurable path exclusions.
